objective: Speak with Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

description: A hunter by the name of Torwa Pathfinder has requested the help of a druid.  He said only we would possess the necessary skills and respect for nature to help him.
There is a road that connects the Un'Goro Crater and the desert of Tanaris.  As that road enters the crater, you will find Torwa close by.
completion: You have traveled far to meet with me, <class>, and not a moment too soon.
